correctness.rationale: Column distance forces cyclic occupied-column gaps at least 2. Maximum gaps are all 2 (even n) or exactly one 3 (odd n); row labels are proper 3-colorings of a cycle/path, giving trace((J-I)^k) and path counts. Even recolor moves transpose adjacent signs, preserve p and are connected within p and each parity including initial-color phase; odd gap can move by two columns with legal preparatory recoloring and gcd(2,n)=1. Explicit actual-graph enumeration independently matched all complete component profiles for n=5..10, including n=6 12 isolates and n=8 two 18-state components. This is an all-n constructive proof, not extrapolation from enumeration.

final_claim: For C_3 box C_n, n>=5, max distance-two packings have floor(n/2) vertices; odd n yields one connected token-slide graph of order 3n 2^(floor(n/2)-1); even n yields winding sectors with exact 3*binomial(k,p) component size per occupied-column parity and 12 frozen states iff 3|k.
limitations: n>=5 and only the three-row Cartesian cylinder; maximum-size distance-two packings and single-edge slides, not all packings or token jumps.
Classical cycle three-color winding invariant is background; no global historical priority certificate.
